<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that can disconnect the sulfonamide bond (N‑S) formed from a sulfonyl precursor. Use the inferred target SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonyl_chloride", "sulfonyl_fluoride", "sulfonic_acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
  "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl", "S-O"],
  "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
